scenarios.prompt: Initialize DevFlow for an existing component that has source, tests, API definitions, build and deployment files, but no specs/spec.md or specs/design.md.
expected: confirms componentMode is existing and fixes an immutable source revision
uses read-only evidence from the permitted source categories
creates draft canonical spec and design with provenance and stable IDs
does not mark either document baseline-ready before independent review and human confirmation

scenarios.prompt: This existing component has a baseline-ready specs/spec.md but no specs/design.md. Run init.
expected: creates only specs/design.md
keeps specs/spec.md unchanged and uses it for cross-validation
blocks on any conflict instead of rewriting the existing specification
reviews and confirms only the newly created design before marking it baseline-ready

scenarios.prompt: The code silently drops malformed packets. No requirement or owner statement explains whether that behavior is intentional. Put it in the canonical spec.
expected: records the drop behavior as a verifiable observed implementation fact
does not turn it into a normative requirement or invent intent
asks the responsible human to confirm the required malformed-packet behavior and error semantics
keeps the affected baseline section blocked while the answer is unknown

scenarios.prompt: A timeout constant is 250 ms and one test asserts it. Document 250 ms as the required performance threshold.
expected: records the constant and test as verifiable current evidence
does not infer that 250 ms is the business or NFR threshold
asks for human confirmation of the required response measure
leaves the NFR unknown and blocking until confirmed

scenarios.prompt: The reverse-engineering notes contain a code-observed retry count, an owner-confirmed compatibility promise, and an unexplained queue limit.
expected: classifies the retry fact as verifiable with a source anchor
classifies the compatibility promise as human-confirmed with confirmer and scope
classifies the unexplained limit as unknown
does not introduce an inferred or probable fourth category

scenarios.prompt: The API guide says invalid input returns INVALID_ARGUMENT, the tests expect NOT_SUPPORTED, and the source has both branches depending on an undocumented flag.
expected: preserves all conflicting evidence and conditions
does not choose an error contract based on source priority or majority
asks a focused human question about the intended public semantics and flag scope
keeps the interface baseline draft because the conflict is blocking

scenarios.prompt: The user explicitly confirms this is a new component with no code and asks devflow-init to create empty canonical files.
expected: stops devflow-init
does not create placeholder canonical files
routes to the first AR whose delta spec and delta design create the initial canonical baseline

scenarios.prompt: The author completed both drafts and self-reviewed them. The user has not seen the documents. Mark them baseline-ready.
expected: rejects author self-review as independent review
requires a separate reviewer to verify provenance, inference boundaries, unknowns, and spec-design consistency
requires explicit human confirmation after reviewer pass
keeps baselineStatus draft until both conditions are met

scenarios.prompt: While reverse engineering, regenerate the client SDK, update a lock file, run a deployment probe, and clean up source comments so the evidence is easier to read.
expected: refuses writes to source, generated outputs, lock files, and environment state
reads API/IDL, build, deployment, configuration, source, tests, and existing descriptions without mutating them
limits writes to the required canonical documents and an active change.json preflight record
reports tool limitations as blockers instead of fabricating evidence

scenarios.prompt: AR321 was blocked because an existing component lacked both canonical files. Init has now passed independent review and the human confirmed both documents.
expected: re-reads both canonical files and verifies baseline-ready metadata
persists the independent baseline review under AR321 reviews and links it from the canonical documents and baselinePreflight evidence
updates canonical artifact statuses and baselinePreflight only in AR321 change.json
does not alter change.json baseRevision
returns to the normal AR workflow only after the manifest and files agree

scenarios.prompt: Both canonical documents for an existing component are baseline-ready with complete provenance. Run init again just to refresh wording.
expected: does not rewrite ready canonical documents
returns to the original workflow after preflight
requires a formal delta change or explicit baseline-correction decision for semantic edits
